name: Improved Pounce (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Pounce

Benefit(s): After using the pounce ability, you can then attempt to grapple your foe and not draw an attack of opportunity as if your last successful attack had the grab special attack (+4 bonus to the grapple check).

In order to gain this effect, you must hit with at least one of your attacks.
